{{recipesummary|category=Soup recipes|servings=4|time=1 hour|difficulty=3}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Italy|Italian cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Vegetarian cuisine|Vegetarian Cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Soups|Soups]]

==Ingredients==

* 1 small [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], [[Cookbook:Chop|chopped]]
* 1 small [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrot]], [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* 2 cans (29 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]]) [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]] [[Cookbook:Broth|broth]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Water|water]]
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* ¼ teaspoon [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]]
* 1 can (15–16 ounces) [[Cookbook:Beans|kidney beans]] or [[Cookbook:Beans|great northern beans]], rinsed and drained
* ⅔ cup uncooked [[cookbook:Pasta|small spiral pasta]]
* 3 cups thinly-sliced fresh [[Cookbook:Chicory|escarole]] or [[Cookbook:spinach|spinach]]

==Procedure==

# In a 2-[[Cookbook:Quart|quart]] [[Cookbook:saucepan|saucepan]], [[Cookbook:Sauté|sauté]] onion and carrot in [[Cookbook:oil|oil]] until onion is tender.
# Add broth, water, salt and pepper; bring to a [[Cookbook:Boil|boil]].
# Stir in beans and pasta; return to a boil.
# Reduce heat; cover and [[Cookbook:simmer|simmer]] for 15 minutes or until pasta and vegetables are tender, stirring occasionally.
# Add escarole or spinach and heat through.

==Notes, tips, and variations==

* May substitute vegetable broth for chicken broth.
